title.en: Check the hosts your certificates name

detail.en: Every certificate you issue names its hosts in a public log, so staging, admin and test hosts are easy to find. Each one should be gone, behind a login, or meant to be public.

forwardable.en: Or forward it to your developer — it reads the same either way.

body.en:
Public certificate logs name these hosts under {{domain}}: {{hosts}}. Their names suggest non-production or internal services. For each one, decide whether it should exist at all, and if it should, whether it should answer to the public internet or only behind a login or the office network. Remove what is dead, restrict what is internal, and make sure none of them serves a copy of production data.

When you are done: list each host with what you decided and how to confirm it from outside the network.
